description: sdlc: security-guidance (pattern warnings, diff + commit review), hookify (rules from .claude/hookify.*.local.md and committed .claude/hookify/*.md; evaluated before tool use, on prompts and on stop); verify-freshness (Prove, Stage 5, only; Stage 6 too on the Lite flow: blocks finishing on stale test results); prove-budget (Prove, Stage 5, only: commands other than the project's own are killed at 120 s and never run in the background); model-router (active feature only: subagent dispatches name a model, fable needs the user's opt-in, every code review runs on opus, the other reviewers, the verifier and the qa-tester on opus on Track L), with role-guard (the plugin's agents stay in their role) and trust-anchor (changes to what verification trusts reach the user)
